records.title: Modern warfare FPS gameplay
records.useCase: First-person AAA shooter gameplay with full HUD
records.prompt: Camera: First-person perspective at eye level with authentic handheld player movement, as if recorded directly from a modern AAA military shooter. The player carries a highly detailed assault rifle with realistic animations, visible hands, tactical gloves, dynamic reload mechanics, and weapon sway.  **Opening Action:** The video immediately begins with the player already aiming down a roadway inside a modern military base. Multiple enemy soldiers are visible in the distance near sandbags, barricades, and military vehicles. The player carefully tracks one target, making small aim corrections while maintaining ADS (aim down sights). Fire several controlled bursts immediately at the visible enemies, producing realistic muzzle flashes, shell casings ejecting, smoke, recoil, hit reactions, and dust impacts around the targets. Continue firing in multiple short bursts while adjusting aim between enemies, simulating authentic FPS gameplay rather than scripted animation.  **Movement:** After the opening firefight, lower slightly from ADS and begin advancing cautiously along the road beside concrete barriers, Hesco walls, and parked military vehicles. Frequently check left and right corners, briefly stop to reacquire targets, then raise the weapon and fire additional controlled bursts whenever enemies appear ahead. Continue pushing forward with deliberate player-controlled movement, using cover naturally and maintaining believable tactical pacing.  **Environment:** Large modern military base with guard towers, armored vehicles, shipping containers, blast barriers, damaged buildings, smoke plumes, burning debris, scattered shell casings, dust clouds, and atmospheric battlefield haze. Cool natural daylight mixed with smoke and orange firelight creates a cinematic battlefield atmosphere.  **Camera Motion:** Authentic player-controlled movement with subtle head bob, weapon sway, natural mouse-look adjustments, small left-right corrections while aiming, realistic recoil, smooth tracking of moving targets, brief pauses before shooting, and fluid forward progression. Avoid cinematic camera moves—everything should feel like genuine live gameplay captured by a skilled player.  **Visual Quality:** Ultra-photorealistic, AAA game graphics with realistic PBR materials, detailed weapon models, physically accurate lighting, volumetric smoke, dynamic particle effects, crisp textures, realistic bullet impacts, muzzle flash illumination, motion blur only during rapid movement, and high-end military shooter presentation.  **Gameplay UI:** Display a realistic modern FPS HUD inspired by games like PUBG, Battlefield, or Call of Duty (without copying exact copyrighted assets). Include:  * Central dynamic crosshair or reticle * Ammo counter with magazine and reserve ammunition * Fire mode indicator * Compass at the top * Squad/team status panel * Mini-map in the upper corner * Health bar * Tactical equipment icons (grenades, medkit) * Hit markers when bullets connect * Directional damage indicators * Kill notification feed * Objective marker in the distance * Subtle interaction prompts and realistic HUD animations  The HUD should feel polished, modern, and fully integrated into the gameplay, enhancing the illusion of authentic recorded footage from a contemporary military FPS.

records.title: Radio operator evacuation bridge
records.prompt:
FORMAT
15 seconds | 16:9 | photoreal live-action war thriller
Fictional Sahelian city at blue-hour dawn.
Urgent, human, suspenseful, non-graphic.

REFERENCE CONTROL
Image 1 = locked AMINA identity and wardrobe.
Preserve face, close-cropped hair, deep-brown skin, navy field jacket, silver earpiece, canvas satchel, analogue radio, boots and determined expression.

Image 2 = locked environment.
Preserve concrete bridge, dry riverbed, dense low-rise city, rooftop antennae, dusty atmosphere, cool-blue shadows and restrained amber dawn.

No real countries, flags, organizations or landmarks.

STORY
Amina is the last radio operator keeping an evacuation bridge open. Communications fail during a distant attack. She must activate the backup relay and transmit clearance before automatic controls close the bridge.

00–02s — CHANNEL OFFLINE
Extreme close-up inside a dark concrete communications room.

Amina grips the analogue radio as red emergency lights pulse. Dust trembles, cables quiver, broken static fills the room.

Automated voice:
“Emergency channel offline.”

She looks up and immediately moves.

02–04s — BRIDGE CLOSING
Wide aerial-oblique rooftop view.

Civilians cross the bridge through windblown dust.

Checkpoint signal flickers green → red as shutdown begins.

A distant shockwave moves through city haze. No visible casualties.

04–06.5s — RUN
Low handheld tracking behind Amina running through a damaged service corridor.

Emergency lights flash, dust falls, cables briefly spark, boots hit wet concrete.

She pushes through a heavy metal door into blowing dust.

06.5–09s — FLASHBACK
Two minutes earlier.

Medium side-profile on rooftop.

Amina sees the unstable bridge signal, manually rotates the antenna and connects her radio to backup power.

Slow camera push. Wind moves her satchel strap as first amber sunlight reaches her jacket.

09–12.5s — TRANSMISSION
Rapid cross-cut montage:

frequency dial locks →
antenna aligns →
bridge cables vibrate →
red signal flashes →
Amina speaks into radio:

“Channel Seven, keep the bridge open.”

Overhead shot: civilians continue crossing.

Sharp hard cuts, brief black frames, natural motion blur.

12.5–15s — SIGNAL RESTORED
Sound suddenly drops.

Amina listens on the rooftop.

Clear radio tone.

Checkpoint signal changes red → steady green.

Evacuation continues.

Amina exhales and watches the bridge as dawn reaches the city.

Slow push toward her face.
Cut to black.

CAMERA
Large-format live-action realism.
Precise nonlinear cross-cutting.
Handheld tracking, aerial-oblique coverage, restrained push-ins and close details.
Natural motion blur, fine film grain, subtle gate weave.
No impossible camera movement.

ENVIRONMENT + PHYSICS
Cool-blue shadows against muted amber sunrise.
Deep blacks, dusty atmosphere, weathered concrete.

Wind realistically affects dust, clothing, cables and antenna equipment.
All movement and interactions remain physically believable.

AUDIO
Stereo radio static, electrical hum, wind, boots, antenna creaks, distant low artillery and helicopter rotors.

Restrained suspenseful sub-bass builds through the montage.

VISUAL
Photoreal cinematic war-thriller footage.
Immense scale contrasted with one determined operator.
Grounded, tense and human.

No subtitles, text, logos, watermarks, political messaging, flags or military insignia.

CONTINUITY
Same Amina identity, wardrobe, radio and satchel throughout.
Same bridge, city, atmosphere and dawn lighting.
Maintain geographic and temporal continuity across all shots.

records.title: Giant koi park incident
records.prompt: 15-second, 16:9 vertical, continuous single-take video that looks like authentic smartphone footage accidentally captured by a passerby in a city park. Overcast natural daylight, subtle handheld shake, limited phone stabilization, occasional autofocus adjustment, and realistic smartphone compression. The absurd event is filmed with a completely serious, unscripted documentary feeling.  0–3s: [Handheld medium shot] A middle-aged man wearing a dark business suit and tie crouches beside the stone edge of a pond. With a completely serious expression, he slowly scatters pieces of bread from a paper bag to several ordinary koi. Small ripples spread across the water as the fish gather in front of him.  3–7s: [Camera instinctively moves closer] An abnormally huge orange-and-white koi suddenly surges out of the murky water, briefly lifting its upper body above the surface and biting down on the entire bread bag in the man’s left hand. He freezes for half a second, then grips the bag with both hands and leans backward. Startled, the person filming steps back. The image briefly loses focus before locking onto the man and the giant fish again.  7–11s: [Close handheld action shot] The giant koi pulls violently toward the deeper part of the pond. The wet paper bag stretches, the man’s arms tense, and his leather shoes slide repeatedly across the wet stone. His knee strikes the edge of the pond. He tries to brace himself with his right foot, but the sole loses traction and his center of gravity moves past the edge. Water, pieces of bread, and fallen leaves scatter from the force as the camera operator hurriedly moves sideways.  11–15s: [Impact and final hold] The paper bag suddenly tears. The man loses all support and pitches forward into the pond, creating one heavy, realistic splash. The camera quickly tilts downward while keeping the center of the pond visible. The man resurfaces with duckweed covering his head and his wet tie stuck across his face. The giant koi calmly swims past him with the remains of the bread bag still in its mouth. The camera holds on the man’s stunned expression while the koi casually swims away beside him.  Keep the man’s face, dark suit, tie, and paper bag visually consistent throughout. The koi must retain the same orange-and-white markings and enormous size. The pulling, sliding, loss of balance, and fall must show believable weight, inertia, traction, and water displacement. Natural park ambience and a realistic splash only. No dialogue, no subtitles, no music. Avoid cuts, character teleportation, changes in the fish’s size, extra limbs, and cartoonish acting.

records.title: Greenhouse tea isekai anime
records.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。

作品トーンと世界観は、透明感のある夏のガラス温室から、紅茶の渦の内側に存在するオリジナルの小さな不思議の国へ連続する、上品で夢幻的な叙情ファンタジー。澄んだ白、水色、琥珀色、淡い金色を主役にし、怖さや混沌ではなく、好奇心、浮遊感、静かな高揚を描く。今回は1枚のソース参照画像image1のみを使用し、image1をキャラクター、衣装、2D手描き画風、配色、現実側のガラス温室背景の唯一の参照として扱う。

【同一人物固定】
image1と完全に同じ一人の少女を全編で維持する。小さく繊細な同じ顔立ち、大きな青緑色の宝石のような瞳、同じ目の形、多層の虹彩と白いキャッチライト、淡い頬、細いまつ毛、真珠のような白銀髪、柔らかな長いウェーブ、編み込みを含むまとめ髪、淡い金色のリボン、青い雫形の髪飾りを固定する。表情変化でも目、眉、まぶた、口、視線の順を守る。白い長袖のハイネックドレス、淡い水色の刺繍と縁取り、淡い金色の腰リボン、華奢で上品な体格、白・水色・淡い金色の人物固有配色を変えない。現実の温室と不思議の国に同時に複数の少女を存在させず、光学トランジションの前後で同じ一人の少女として連続させる。変えてよいのは表情、視線、呼吸、歩行、手の動き、髪と袖とスカート裾の自然な揺れだけ。別人化、顔の平均化、衣装変更、装飾欠落、分身、余分な人物、既存作品を想起させる有名キャラクターを出さない。
【2D hand-drawn／2D手描き画風固定】
image1の細く淡い青灰色と暖灰色の線、透明感のある二層以上の色影、柔らかなグラデーション、白・ミルキーブルー・澄んだ空色・琥珀色・淡い金色の明るい配色を全編で維持する。白銀髪の真珠質ハイライト、瞳の多層反射、肌の淡い発光感、ドレスの皺と刺繍、花、葉、ガラス、白い家具、床タイル、紅茶まで高密度の手描き筆致で描く。布は柔らかく、ガラスは透明で硬質、紅茶は澄んだ琥珀色、異世界の道と建築は半透明の白いガラス質として素材を描き分ける。太い輪郭にしない。簡略TVアニメにしない。平坦な単層セル影にしない。低密度背景にしない。滑らかなCG・3Dにしない。半写実にしない。実写にしない。くすんだ色や画風混合にしない。

【舞台と小物固定】
現実側はimage1と同じ明るいガラス温室。白い窓枠と屋根骨格、青空と白い雲、外の緑と白い花、白い丸テーブル、白い金属椅子、淡い青灰色の床タイルを維持する。開始時はimage1の少女の顔、目、髪、衣装、温室背景、白・水色・淡い金色の配色、明るさ、柔らかなコントラストを維持し、追加される小物はティーポットだけ。小物の所有者はimage1の少女一人だけ。透明なガラスのティーポット一つ、透明なティーカップ一つ、透明なソーサー一つだけを使う。開始状態ではティーカップはソーサー中央に置かれ、底に浅い琥珀色の紅茶が入っている。少女は右手でティーポットの取っ手を持ち、左手はソーサーの横へ軽く添える。ティーポット、カップ、ソーサーを増殖、交換、変形させない。不思議の国ではこれらを人物や巨大な小道具として複製しない。
少女の表情は、目→眉→まぶた→口→視線の順に変化させる。まず左右の目の中にある小さなキャッチライトがわずかに明るくなり、次に眉が少し上がり、その後まぶたが柔らかく開き、口元に小さな驚きと微笑みが生まれ、最後に視線が渦の中心へ下がる。反射線、窓枠、光点を顔中央へ重ねず、顔と両目を常に明瞭に保つ。

最初のカメラ高は白い丸テーブルと同じ低い位置。少女の斜め前から、手前にティーカップとソーサーを大きく、奥に少女の胸上と顔を明瞭に置く。背景消失軸は床タイルと右側の窓枠が温室奥へ斜めに伸びる方向へ揃える。この構図の目的は、少女、ポット先端、カップ中央の着水点を最初の一画で同時に読ませること。
少女が右手首だけをゆっくり傾けると、ティーポットの先端から一筋だけの琥珀色の紅茶がカップ中央へ落ちる。ポット先端、液体の筋、着水点を一画で読み取れるようにし、紅茶はテーブル外へこぼれない。この着水点を変化の起点とする。着水点から一つの時計回りの渦が生まれ、青空の反射と淡い金色の日差しを巻き込みながら、琥珀、青、白の三色の螺旋へ育つ。

カメラはテーブルと同じ低い位置からカップの斜め上へ滑らかに上がり、人物サイズを胸上の中景から背景の顔が読める近景へ保ったまま、紅茶面へ近づく。背景消失軸は温室奥から円形のカップ中央へ収束させる。この移動の目的は、現実の着水点を異世界への案内線へ変えること。

螺旋の半分がまだ琥珀色の紅茶、もう半分が細い光の道になっている形成中の中間状態を短く明瞭に見せる。続いて螺旋が画面全体を満たした瞬間、その同じ回転方向、曲率、色の並びを保ったまま、一本の光の道へ完成する。暗転、瞬間移動、破裂、液体の中を溺れる表現にせず、紅茶面から異世界の俯瞰へ連続する光学的な形状一致として接続する。

変化後の完成状態である不思議の国は、傾いた白いガラスの庭道、空中でゆっくり反転する白い花壇、輪のように連なる温室アーチ、上下が穏やかに入れ替わる空色の庭で構成する。文字盤、数字、看板、動物、人型住民は出さない。

カメラ高は少女の胸より少し低い位置へ移り、同じ少女の斜め前を後退しながら、胸から膝までの中景で追従する。背景消失軸は琥珀と青の光の道が円形アーチの奥へ伸びる方向へ揃える。この移動の目的は、紅茶の渦だった曲線が少女を導く冒険路へ変わったことを読ませること。

少女は光の道に沿って軽やかに三歩進み、第一歩で傾いた庭道へ乗り、第二歩で浮かぶ白い床片を渡り、第三歩で円形のガラスアーチをくぐる。各足裏を順に接地させ、髪、袖、スカート裾は歩みより少し遅れて同じ風向きへ揺れる。滑走、飛行、急回転に見せない。

少女がアーチをくぐると、周囲の白い花が外側から順に淡い水色へ染まり、頭上のガラス骨格がゆっくり四分の一回転して上下の庭をつなぐ。少女自身は直立を保ち、重力方向を急変させない。

カメラは胸より少し低い位置を保って少女の肩越しへ短く回り込み、人物サイズを胸上に寄せる。背景消失軸は前方の光の道が作る一つの円へ収束させる。この移動の目的は、少女の冒険の先に帰還路が生まれることを示すこと。光の道は再び一つの時計回りの螺旋となり、その円周が現実のティーカップの縁と同じ形、大きさ、角度へ整列する。

カメラは螺旋の中心を通り、琥珀色の紅茶面の極近景から現実の温室へ滑らかに引く。カメラ高はテーブルと同じ低い位置へ戻り、人物サイズを奥の胸上へ戻す。背景消失軸は円形のカップ中央から床タイルと窓枠が温室奥へ伸びる開始方向へ戻す。この移動の目的は、異世界の冒険を一杯の紅茶の中へ回収し、少女の感情へ報酬を返すこと。同じ少女が帰還した連続性を保つ。

終端では少女が右手のティーポットを垂直へ戻し、紅茶の筋をきれいに止め、ティーポットを胸より低い高さで保持する。左手はソーサー横に添えたまま。カップ内の最後の渦がゆっくり縮み、中心に青と淡い金の小さな反射一つだけを残して静止する。

カメラはテーブル高さの斜め前で、手前の静かな紅茶面、奥の少女の三分の四顔と穏やかな微笑みを同時に読ませる。紅茶面の反射が完全に止まり、少女の両目、ティーポット、カップ、渦の名残が一画で明瞭になった瞬間に切る。

液体を黒く濁らせない。渦を黒い穴、荒れた水面、別形状の物体へ変えない。顔を歪ませない。手指を増やさない。余分な人物や余分な食器を出さない。ストロボ、激しい明滅、強い水平フレア、白飛びなし。文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしなし。BGMなし、音楽なし、環境音なし、フォーリーなし、音響生成なし。

records.title: Storm-Lit Pirate Galleon Battle
records.prompt:
Open ocean, storm-lit sky, two massive wooden galleons broadside to broadside, cannons blazing, sails torn and smoking.

LOCATION: towering waves, rain-slicked decks, splintering wood, the ships as looming wooden fortresses dwarfing the men fighting on them. Grey-green storm light, cannon smoke rolling across the water like fog.

ACTORS: two pirate crews — one crew in ragged dark coats and bandanas led by a scarred captain wielding a cutlass and flintlock; the other crew in stolen naval coats, more disciplined but outnumbered. Dozens of background fighters clashing across both decks.

MOVEMENT: heavy, physical combat — swinging on rigging ropes across the gap between ships, cutlass clashes with real weight and follow-through, men thrown by cannon blasts, boots slipping on wet planks.

INTERACTION: the two captains as the emotional throughline — circling each other through the chaos, their duel the spine of the sequence while the crews fight around them.

CINEMATOGRAPHY (Kubrick-style): open with a long, wide, almost painterly establishing shot of the two ships closing in through the storm — hold it, let the dread build before the first cannon fires. Use symmetry in the initial approach (ships mirrored on either side of frame), then shatter that order completely once battle erupts. Favor a few extended tracking shots through the melee (a single unbroken move weaving across the deck) rather than only quick cuts, so the audience feels physically present in the chaos, punctuated by hard cuts at moments of violence.

CUTS:

1. Wide establishing shot: the two galleons converging through rain and swell, lightning flashing behind torn sails, ominous and silent but for wind and creaking timber. Hold long.

2. Close-up: the pirate captain's face, rain streaming down a scarred cheek, eyes narrowing, hand tightening on his cutlass hilt.

3. Wide shot: cannons fire in unison from both ships — deafening flash and smoke, the hulls shuddering, wood splintering on impact, rigging snapping and crashing to the deck.

4. Grappling hooks fly across the gap, biting into the enemy ship's rail; ships lurch together with a groan of timber as the gap closes.

5. Long tracking shot: pirates swing across on ropes into the fray, landing mid-swing into combat — camera follows one pirate's full arc from rail to rail without cutting, weapons clashing all around as he lands and immediately engages.

6. Fast cuts through the melee: cutlass parries, a pistol shot at close range, a man thrown overboard by a cannon's recoil, barrels rolling loose across the tilting deck.

7. Medium shot: the two captains spot each other across the chaos, a beat of stillness in the middle of battle, then they cut a path toward one another through the fighting.

8. Close-up duel: blades clash in tight, brutal exchanges, rain and sweat, snarled dialogue, one captain slammed back against the mast.

9. Wide shot: a mast cracks and begins to fall, crew scattering, fire catching on torn sailcloth, chaos peaking as both crews scramble.

10. Final close combat: the rival captain disarmed, blade at his throat — beat of hesitation, thunder cracks, and the scene holds on the standoff rather than resolving cleanly, smoke and rain swirling around them both.

Camera: mostly handheld-feel tracking shots through the melee for immersion, hard cuts on cannon fire and key hits, a still symmetrical wide shot to open

records.prompt:
Prompt #MiniMaxH3 in Chinese:

15秒 | 16:9 | 1440p | 24fps | 无缝循环

[角色锁定] 完全按照 @image1 呈现，不进行任何重新设计。蓬松的蓝灰色波浪短发，刘海垂落遮住上半张脸；面容清秀，唇色偏暖；珊瑚朱红色宽袖长袍，腰间层层缠绕的宽腰带，深色内衬；持剑手戴深色手套。长剑：华丽的银金巴洛克护手与柄头，镜面剑身映出真实的天空与云。全片不得改动发量与卷曲走向、刘海遮眼的方式、袍身轮廓、腰带缠法、手套、护手纹样与剑身比例。

[循环 · 核心设定] 剑身自第一帧起就已布满一张固定的旧金脉之网——那是它此前碎裂并被金继修补留下的痕迹。本片是这一循环中的又一次：它沿着既有金脉再次裂开，碎片散去，熔金重新灌回同样的裂缝，恢复成完全相同的样子。不增添任何新金脉、不改变其走向与数量。最后一帧须与第一帧完全一致。

[剑的恒定 · 最高优先级] 重铸后的剑必须与开场完全相同：长度、宽度、弧度、剑尖、护手雕花、柄头、缠柄、镜面质感、金脉走向数量粗细、刻痕位置，逐一对应。严禁任何形态变化——不得变长变大、不得生出新纹饰或棱刺、不得产生光晕或能量外溢、不得改变颜色材质、不得出现任何“进化”“觉醒”“强化形态”式转变。金只填回原有裂缝，绝不溢出剑身之外、绝不覆盖镜面。

[解剖锁定 · 最高优先级] 全片有且仅有一名人物：两条手臂、两只手、每只手五指、一把剑。严禁多余的手臂、手掌、手指或第二把武器。高速转身与运动模糊中，残影绝不可被渲染成额外肢体。手部每帧结构完整、指节分明；戴手套的手握柄，空出的手须清晰可见且有明确朝向。

[沉浸 · 观众入画] 画面本身是一张真实存在的和纸，镜头是观众伸进这个世界的一只眼睛，世界会反过来影响它。
一、画面裂纹：0.9 秒剑开裂的同一帧，一道极细的裂纹自画面中心向四角蔓延，如同观看的这块玻璃也被划开；裂纹全片存在并缓慢加深，10.8 秒起被金继之金一并填补，13.8 秒前完全消失。
二、纸的边界：画面四边的和纸纤维始终微微起伏，重击时被掀起并向内卷曲，露出纸的毛边。
三、墨上镜头：3.2 秒的长弧甩出的墨点直接溅在镜头上，附着后沿纸纤维缓慢晕开，随后逐渐变淡，13.8 秒前完全干透消失。
四、倒影中的观众：2.2 秒与 13.4 秒各有一片碎片旋转至极近处，其镜面中短暂映出镜头本身与其外的一片天光，仿佛观众看见了自己所在的位置——只出现一瞬即转开。
五、沉入：7.0 至 8.8 秒，墨云直扑镜头并将其吞没，镜头沉入墨中——四周被浓墨包裹，仅上方透出天光与她的剪影，纸纤维如絮状物在“水中”缓缓漂过，画面轻微起伏如同随液体晃动；8.8 秒墨向下退去，镜头破“水面”而出。
所有以上效果必须在 13.8 秒前彻底清除，最后一帧的画面须与第一帧一样干净。

[场景 · 明亮] 高空之上，正午。头顶通透饱和的湛蓝天空，向地平线渐变为明亮浅色薄雾；脚下极远处是被阳光照亮的洁白积云海。她悬浮其中——无地面、无建筑、无道具。金箔长带随上升气流飘过。全片阳光充沛、明亮通透，绝不转阴、绝不去饱和。

[色彩] 天空 #2E6FA8 渐变至 #CFE3EF。长袍珊瑚朱红 #D9563F，褶皱 #A63A2A。头发蓝灰 #8CA3B8，边缘接暖色轮廓光。手套与内衬 #14161C。护手做旧银金。碎片映出真实蓝天白云。墨为纯黑 #0A0A0C。金脉为哑光金箔 #C9962E，熔金前沿炽白金 #FFEBB0，冷却后回到完全相同的 #C9962E。

[风格与质感] 水墨画与照相级玻璃的融合。整个画面覆盖极淡的和纸纤维质感；天空与云以水墨渲染，边缘晕开带枯笔飞白；人物与剑为完全清晰的实体渲染，如实体嵌在画中。金为真实金箔——极薄、有褶皱、氧化磨损、受光不均。碎片有真实厚度与内部裂纹，每片映出不同的云。发丝逐根渲染，逆光半透明；袍料厚重，褶皱有真实重量与回弹；护手雕花凹处压暗。胶片高光滚降，金上柔和光晕，细腻颗粒。

[特效] 逐级升级：剑锋所过之处墨如入水般翻卷晕开；金箔自长带剥落飘散；墨与金彼此排斥绝不相融，如大理石纹互相推挤；高速动作拖出枯笔飞白擦痕；每次重击有一帧纯墨黑剪影；熔金沿裂缝奔流，前沿炽白，其后冷却为哑光金箔。

[动画法则] 每个动作遵循预备—爆发—收势：出手前明确反向蓄势，爆发只占少数帧，收势有减速与轻微过冲后回位，绝不匀速。发丝、宽袖、袍摆、腰带末端各以不同延迟跟随身体，绝不同步启停。所有轨迹为弧线。高空中一切略带浮力感。杜绝任何僵硬、停顿或不自然的关节角度。

[逐拍动作]
0.0-1.4 她双手垂落，右手握剑于身侧偏后，剑斜指下方，头微低、刘海遮眼；仅呼吸使胸口微起伏。剑沿一道既有金脉裂开，手指本能收紧一下。
1.4-3.2 剑沿所有金脉同时裂开脱手，碎片向外散开，断口边缘皆为原有的金。右手仍维持握持姿势停在半空，指节微张；左手抬至胸前，掌心向上；头始终微低。
3.2-5.2 右手将空柄自身侧向斜上方划出完整长弧，腰胯先行带动肩背，宽袖甩开翻卷；收势时手腕轻微过冲后回位，左手向后平展保持平衡。
5.2-7.0 侧身转体半周，重心自右脚移至左脚，袍摆螺旋展开；转身中右手将空柄换至身前反握，左手抬至面侧。
7.0-8.8 虚空中一蹬，身体略下沉蓄势，双臂猛地向两侧张开召回碎片；随后双臂收拢至胸前，掌心相对，碎片锁定成环。
8.8-10.8 一次真实的挥臂与转身，被不同渲染风格切分呈现。
10.8-13.0 右手缓缓翻转、掌心向上再合拢，碎片沿手臂旋绕归位；剑成形时五指依次收紧扣柄，手臂承力下沉半寸，肩线压低。
13.0-13.8 第一次抬起头，刘海被气流分开露出双眼，平视镜头；手腕转动一周使金脉迎光。
13.8-15.0 缓缓垂下手腕，剑回到身侧偏后斜指下方；头重新低下，刘海落回遮眼，左手垂落身侧——完全回到第一帧姿势。

[表演] 全片沉静克制。碎裂时无惊慌，只有指节一次收紧；召回时下颌微抬、呼吸加深；金脉合拢时嘴角极细微的松动；抬头对视时眼神平静笃定；垂下头时回归最初的静默。

[署名] 剑身护手上方刃根处刻有 CIA0（大写 C、大写 I、大写 A、数字零；末位是数字零而非字母 O），小号宽字距镌刻大写，是剑本身的一部分，绝非叠加图层。刻痕内自第一帧起已嵌金，重铸后完全相同，绝不变亮变大或增添装饰。

[文字 · 墨落纸上] 所有文字为湿润毛笔书法渗入画面本身的和纸纤维：落笔带刷毛痕迹与枯笔断白，墨沿纤维晕开一拍后随纸干淡去。拉丁文为厚重镌刻衬线，日文为浓墨重笔竖排于侧三分之一。文字位于她身后并被遮挡，绝不覆盖面部。以下须原样逐字呈现：
0.8秒「墨」竖排右三分之一
2.4秒 "IT HAS BROKEN BEFORE" 单行靠左
5.0秒 "EVERY CRACK" / "REMEMBERS THE SKY" 两行堆叠靠左
7.6秒「金継」竖排左三分之一，墨将干时自笔画渗出金色
10.6秒 "AND WILL AGAIN" 先落墨再被金箔灌满
13.2秒 居中标题组：「天墨」上方，"INKFALL" 下方，须在 14.4 秒前完全淡去，最后一帧不得残留任何文字

@Image1 [摄影] 变形宽银幕，椭圆焦外，暖色条状光斑，180 度快门，轻微桶形畸变。摇臂有质量、起停缓入缓出；甩镜末端轻微过冲后回稳；移焦有极短过冲再回拉。前景始终有金箔长带、碎片或袍袖掠过制造视差。
0.0-1.4 100mm 微距沿镜面剑身向护手行进，云影流过钢面，金脉与刻痕掠过。
1.4-3.2 35mm 环绕碎片场 180 度，穿行于碎片之间。
3.2-5.2 24mm 广角随长弧上升，天空大面积入画。
5.2-7.0 18mm 一镜到底，推入一片碎片的倒影穿过，自另一侧高处回望她。
7.0-8.8 沉入墨中，镜头略微上仰仰望她的剪影，随液体轻微起伏。
8.8-10.8 焦段随拍点跳切，85mm 特写与 24mm 广角交替。
10.8-13.0 50mm 缓慢推入，荷兰角自五度回正。
13.0-13.8 85mm 面部特写。
13.8-15.0 自面部缓缓下降推近，沿剑身回到 100mm 微距，与第一帧完全对位。

[分镜]
0.0-1.4 循环点。微距沿镜面剑身疾行，云影流过钢面。剑沿一道既有金脉缓慢裂开如薄冰崩解；同一帧，一道细裂纹自画面中心向四角蔓延。墨自裂口涌出黑色羽状云。
1.4-3.2 悬停。镜头环绕漂浮的碎片场，每片缓缓自转，各自捧着一角天空，断口的金边闪烁；2.2 秒一片碎片旋至极近，镜面中一瞬映出镜头本身。她悬于中心，刘海遮眼。
3.2-5.2 墨绽。她以空柄划出长弧，在整片天空拖出巨大水墨笔触，湿黑弧带枯笔飞白；甩出的墨点溅上镜头并沿纸纤维晕开。落入墨中的碎片转为剪影。
5.2-7.0 穿镜。一镜到底：镜头推入一片碎片的倒影并穿过，自另一侧高处回望她；金箔长带掠过镜头，她的转身拖出枯笔擦痕。
7.0-8.8 沉入。墨云直扑镜头并将其吞没——四周被浓墨包裹，仅上方透出天光与她张开双臂的剪影，纸纤维如絮状物缓缓漂过，画面随液体轻微起伏，画面裂纹在墨中被压出细密支线。8.8 秒墨向下退去，镜头破出水面，碎片同帧翻转锁成绕她缓转的环。
8.8-10.8 水墨蒙太奇，一帧一姿态交替渲染：纸白底纯墨线稿、朱红与青蓝二色木版画帧、黑底金箔剪影、枯笔拖影帧、一帧全画面墨色反转、完整渲染。墨点与金屑持续累积绝不重置。
10.8-13.0 金继。碎片沿手臂旋绕归位，断口一一对上；熔金沿原有裂缝灌回，前沿炽白，其后冷却为哑光金箔，最终与开场金脉完全一致，不多一道不少一道。同时画面上那道裂纹也被金一并填补、随后金色渐渐淡去。全画面光线转暖。
13.0-13.8 对视。她第一次抬头，刘海分开露出双眼，平视镜头；13.4 秒一片余留的碎片旋过，镜面中再度一瞬映出镜头。手腕转动一周使金脉迎光。
13.8-15.0 归位。她垂下手腕与视线，剑回到身侧，刘海落回遮眼；镜头上的墨点干透消失，画面裂纹与金色痕迹尽数退去，文字淡尽；镜头沿剑身回到开场微距。最后一帧与第一帧完全一致。

[音频] 每个音效卡在准确帧上，混音首尾相接可循环。底层：高空稀薄空气感，远处持续的风，一层极淡的纸张摩挲声。
0.0-1.4 上行金属长鸣，玻璃缓慢开裂的绵长脆响，接墨入水的低沉涌动，画面裂开时一记极细的近场脆响仿佛就在耳边。
1.4-3.2 近乎静默——碎片自转的细微水晶轻响，墨翻卷的低频液流，一次屏住的呼吸。
3.2-5.2 宽阔湿笔拖过纸面的摩擦，墨沿纤维扩散的细密嘶声，墨点溅上镜头的一记极近的湿响，其下尺八吐息升起。
5.2-7.0 进入碎片时气压骤降，内部闷响的封闭音，穿出一记清亮释放，金箔长带掠过的猎猎。
7.0-8.8 沉入——全频瞬间被厚重低通滤波吞没，只余低沉的液体涌动、遥远变形的风声与一次缓慢的心跳；8.8 秒破水而出，高频与空气感轰然回归。
8.8-10.8 八记毛笔击打卡在每次剪辑上，墨点飞溅，风格间以短滤波门分隔，反转帧一记太鼓。
10.8-13.0 温暖低鸣升起，熔金奔流的柔和噼啪，每道裂缝闭合一声清亮短鸣，古筝音阶逐级上行。
13.0-13.8 延长的尺八长音，剑身转动的清亮金属鸣响。
13.8-15.0 一切收束——袖摆落定的柔响，一次平缓呼气，解析为与开场完全相同的高空风声与纸声，无缝接回起点。
配乐：极简温暖，仅古筝与尺八。3.2 秒进入，7.0 至 8.8 秒随沉入被一同滤掉，8.8 秒回归，10.8 秒起弦乐加入，13.8 秒退出仅余风声，与开场首音无缝相接。无对白。

[限制] 只有一名人物，两条手臂，两只手，一把剑。剑自第一帧即带金脉，重铸后与第一帧完全相同，严禁任何形态、尺寸、纹饰、颜色或光效变化。墨保持纯黑、金保持金箔，绝不混合成褐色。所有文字须为湿墨渗入纸面，绝非平贴叠加。镜头上的墨、画面裂纹与金痕须在 13.8 秒前彻底清除。刻痕须准确拼写为 CIA0。除上述文字外无任何标识、水印或字幕。无地面、无建筑、无道具。全片明亮饱和。首尾帧完全一致，两帧中都不得残留任何文字或镜头污迹。

Duration: 15 seconds | Aspect Ratio: 16:9 | Style: Authentic UGC / iPhone selfie-vlog, handheld, natural light, slight motion blur, TikTok/Reels energy — NOT cinematic.
Product Reference: Use the uploaded ramen bowl image as the only product reference. Keep the broth color, noodle thickness, toppings, egg placement, chashu slices, and bowl appearance identical throughout every shot.

records.title: Ice Gunslinger Interactive Web Loop
records.prompt:
@Hailuo_AI Prompt #MiniMaxH3 in Chinese:

无缝循环 | 网页首屏动画

[核心概念] 她的每一个动作都对应一种网页交互行为，她不是站在网页前，而是在演示这个网页如何运作。加载、悬停、点击、滚动、拖拽、轮播、提交、刷新——八种交互依次发生，每一种都有对应的冰质界面反馈。

[人物锁定 · @image1] 完全按照该参考图呈现，不进行任何重新设计。
容貌：年轻女性，薄荷绿齐颏短发，发丝随动作轻扬；锐利的浅青碧色双眼，青色指甲，水晶坠耳饰。
服装：白色剪裁西装——敞开的外套与长裤，领口环绕金色巴洛克卷草纹饰件，肩披缀满蓝色冰晶尖刺的深色皮草披领，腰间垂挂细金链，大腿绑黑色枪套束带。
武器：两把华丽的银质左轮手枪，一手一把，枪管为冰蓝色水晶质，枪身雕花，转轮与击锤细节完整。
场景：宏伟的宫殿大厅，高耸的拱形长窗，暖金色内饰，大理石地面有真实反射。窗外天光冷，室内金暖，冷暖对比贯穿全片。
全片不得改动发型、面容、西装轮廓、金饰卷草纹、披领结构、枪械造型与比例。

[解剖与武器锁定 · 最高优先级] 全片自始至终只有：两条手臂、两只手、每只手五指、恰好两把左轮——右手一把、左手一把，绝无第三把。拖拽段左枪明确入套，左手空出且五指清晰。所有转枪、滑步、射击及其运动模糊中，残影绝不可被渲染成额外肢体或额外枪械；手部每一帧结构完整、指节分明、扳机指位置明确。枪绝不悬空、绝不复制。

[网页 UI/UX 系统 · 冰质界面] 画面按 12 栏网格构建，外边距 6%，栏间距 2%。安全区：第 1 至 5 栏为网页标题与按钮预留，人物与主冰晶结构全程不进入第 1 至 4 栏。
所有界面元素由「冰」构成——发丝级霜线，半透明，具真实折射，如结在一层看不见的玻璃上。界面配色：霜线冰白 #EDF4F8，激活态冰蓝 #9FD8EC，确认态暖金 #D9A94C。
骨架屏：加载段中，尚未「载入」的画面区域以磨砂半透明冰板占位，微微闪烁，内容载入时冰板融化、真实细节浮现。
光标：一枚冰晶准星即是鼠标指针，全片跟随她当前的注意力移动，悬停时展开一圈细霜，点击时收缩并溅霜。
悬停态：被准星悬停的物体表面泛起一层冰蓝微光并轻微上浮。
涟漪反馈：每次「点击」命中处先扩出一圈材质涟漪，再生长冰晶。
滚动条：右缘一根细冰柱随滚动段的横移同步充填。
对齐参考线：拖拽段中，画面闪现发丝级的洋红对齐线 #E23D9B，元素吸附入位时消失。
弹数指示：右下六格冰晶弹仓图标，随射击逐格碎裂。
载入环：一圈环形霜环兼作页面载入条，1.2 秒起步，7.8 秒半圈，11.4 秒闭合爆亮，13.0 秒后逆向融化。
缓动：所有界面与文字入场为标准缓出约 0.4 秒，退场缓入约 0.25 秒，吸附与回弹为轻微过冲后回位，绝不线性、绝不夸张弹跳，多元素错位约 0.06 秒。

[文字系统 · 皆由场景物质生成] 共三处，字形统一为厚重镌刻衬线体——粗竖笔、发丝细横笔、凿刻楔形衬线、宽字距。每处均为三维实体，具厚度、倒角、折射与投影。
以下引号内为画面实际渲染文字，须原样逐字呈现：
1.8秒 "GLACIA"（G-L-A-C-I-A，全大写）由悬浮冰晶碎片在她身侧半空组装，每片旋转就位成为字母的一个刻面，冰体内部具次表面散射与气泡，边缘折射细彩虹，保持两拍后碎为粉雪。
7.4秒 "HAILUO AI"（H-A-I-L-U-O 空格 A-I，全大写）以霜花在最大拱形长窗玻璃上蔓延书写——霜沿字形边缘呈羽毛状结晶生长，背后天光透过微亮，随后被继续蔓延的霜幕吞没。
13.4秒 "Cia0"（大写 C、小写 i、小写 a、数字零；末位是数字零而非字母 O，须更窄更椭圆）以细雕刻纹刻于右枪银质枪身，与周围雕花同深度同色泽，仅在收枪入套、掠射高光扫过的一瞬显现，绝不发光、描边或放大。
全片无任何其他文字、日文字符或字幕。

[色彩] 天空自顶部深海军蓝 #0B2350 至宝石蓝 #12356B，地平线转暖白 #F0E4CE。火柱核心过曝白，向外为浅金 #FFE9B0、琥珀 #FFD98A、橙金 #E8A63C，最外缘半透明热扰动。剑身自剑尖冷青 #9FD8E0 渐变至护手暖金，中段穿插全光谱色散带沿剑身流动。长袍受光面象牙白 #F5EDDC 至暖灰米 #C9BBA4，褶皱深处冷蓝影 #8C93A6。金属高光 #FFF0C0、中调 #E0B454、暗部 #8A6220、最暗带绿调，绝不平涂。日冕自内向外为白、金、琥珀、品红、靛蓝、透明六段。云海暖白 #FFF6E6 至灰蓝 #7E96B4 至紫蓝 #4A5A85。铬色文字与界面 #E8ECEF，带暖琥珀 #D9A05B 轮廓光。全光谱仅以折射形式出现，绝不平涂。

[风格与特效] 电影级手绘感 2.5D 动画，巴洛克式密度。胶片高光滚降，阴影提亮，最亮处柔和光晕，细腻颗粒，饱和浓郁不过曝。皮肤具次表面散射；金色为各向异性拉丝金属；水晶具真实色散；织物为多层布料解算，有惯性与回弹；头发逐丝渲染，逆光半透明。
特效逐级升级：碎片投出硬边 RGB 衍射光带；金色高光上的星芒光斑；火柱以翻腾丝带状降下；上帝之光穿透云海；碎片剥落光之羽；棱镜焦散在肩甲与胸饰上爬行；圆台由内发光；可见的冲击波畸变环；日冕绽放时短暂过曝再回落；空气中始终悬浮尘埃与晶屑。

[摄影] 变形宽银幕，椭圆焦外，蓝金双色条状光斑，180 度快门，轻微桶形畸变。每个镜头都有明确运动动机与前中后三层纵深——云絮、光之羽、晶屑或长袍一角始终位于前景制造视差。人物始终位于第 6 至 12 栏内。
0.0-1.4

@Hailuo_AI @Image1 微距置于水晶剑身内部，在晶体裂隙间穿行，光沿裂纹色散，随后自剑刃穿出进入开阔天空。
1.4-3.2 摇臂沿光环内缘攀升，符文自近及远依次点亮，透视强烈压缩。
3.2-4.6 35mm 弧形轨道绕至碎片之后，全光谱扫过镜头，她以逆光剪影浮现。
4.6-6.0 40mm 低角度缓推，火柱自画面顶部入画与剑尖相接，构图收束为首屏比例。
6.0-7.8 50mm 空中环绕，随她 180 度旋转同步绕行，斩击瞬间升格至四倍慢速再回落。
7.8-9.6 18mm 一镜到底随她坠落穿过光环，穿越时全光谱填满画面，绝不切。
9.6-11.4 焦段随拍点跳切，85mm 特写与 18mm 广角交替，中间插入一次甩镜。
11.4-12.6 摇臂升降加滑动变焦，由低仰角升至面部齐平，背景压缩感随之改变。
12.6-15.0 缓慢后拉，随后沿剑身推进再次进入水晶内部，与第一帧完全对位。
开场与收束段一律使用带光晕的溶解与镜头位移，绝不硬切；仅 9.6 至 11.4 秒使用硬切并加静音门。

[分镜]
0.0-1.4 循环点。镜头在水晶剑身内部穿行，裂纹、气泡与色散缓缓掠过，随后自剑刃穿出，天空豁然展开。四角框线开始延展。
1.4-3.2 点火。摇臂沿环内缘攀升，火沿环周逐个点亮符文奔跑一圈。1.8 秒处一段符文重组为深铬阴刻的 "ASCENSION" 并随环转出画。进度弧起步。
3.2-4.6 浮现。轨道绕至碎片之后，全光谱扫过镜头，她以剪影浮现，双手同握剑柄将剑垂于身前。三层符文环展开，数据列开始滚动。
4.6-6.0 举剑。双手将巨剑举过头顶横持，回到 @image1 姿态，下颌微仰，火柱降下与剑尖相接。"SCROLL" 落位于画面下缘。构图锁定为首屏比例。
6.0-7.8 接光。她将剑举迎向降下的火柱——由剑身承接，双手始终紧握剑柄绝不松手——随即全身旋转 180 度带出一记横斩。棱镜光爆炸开，UI 全线爆红。双眼仍闭合。
7.8-9.6 坠落。她背向下坠穿过光环中心，右手单手持剑于身侧缓慢旋转，左手向上伸展，长袍如伞面张开。一镜到底，穿越瞬间全光谱填满画面。
9.6-11.4 蒙太奇，八拍每拍 0.225 秒：一、白底铬色线稿，仅剑与双臂轮廓；二、平涂光谱色块拼贴；三、二色剪影，象牙白配纯金；四、完整渲染，一记真实的空中回旋；五、拖影帧，拉出长条残像；六、整帧负片反转，仅此一帧；七、铬色线稿叠加彩虹衍射；八、完整渲染并短暂静止。光与云的扰动八拍之间持续累积，绝不重置。
11.4-12.6 顶点。左手回握剑柄，双手同握将剑锋钉入虚空，冲击波向外扩散。她睁开双眼——青碧色，平静，直视镜头。睫毛先分离，眼睑上抬，瞳孔收缩后放大，泪膜捕捉火柱高光，眼角一道光。日冕绽放，进度弧闭合爆亮。
12.6-15.0 归位。她上升落回圆台，双臂举剑横于头顶回到 @image1 姿态，各环反向折叠，日冕收敛为一道金线，双眼闭合。首屏版式于左区组装、保持、溶解。"CIA0" 随环转入画面，被侧光扫过而显现，随后转入正光重新隐没。镜头沿剑身推进，再次进入水晶内部。最后一帧与第一帧完全一致。

[动态] 重量与优雅优先于摆姿势，动作连贯绝不生硬。长袍、卷发与垂带在每次转向时滞后，布料有真实惯性与回弹。巨剑沉重，挥动时可见承力与减速。一切略带高空浮力感。云层流动与人物动作互相影响。杜绝任何僵硬、停顿或不自然的关节角度。

[音频] 每个音效卡在其画面拍点的准确帧上，混音首尾相接可循环。底层：高空空气感，远处风声，极淡持续人声。
0.0-1.4 水晶内部的封闭共鸣，极轻的晶体应力声，穿出剑刃时空气骤然开阔。
1.4-3.2 符文逐个点亮的清脆金属点火声，沿环奔跑形成加速连音，合唱自远处涌起，铬色文字落定时一记低音。
3.2-4.6 全光谱扫过的高频泛音，布料舒展的柔和摩擦，副环展开的层叠环鸣。
4.6-6.0 举剑的低频蓄势，火柱降临的持续嗡鸣，剑尖相接时一声清亮长音。
6.0-7.8 撞击。管风琴与超低频同时落下，玻璃爆裂，反向镲片渐强，警报般明亮的界面爆红音。
7.8-9.6 坠落气压呼啸，入环骤然滤波为水下感合唱，穿出时爆发大空间混响。
9.6-11.4 八记打击声分别卡在八拍上，合唱断奏，每拍之间硬静音门，负片帧加一记反相金属噪音。
11.4-12.6 顶点。完整合唱、管风琴、钟声与一记低沉铜管齐鸣，睁眼那一帧落下一声清亮的钟，混音随日冕展宽。
12.6-15.0 收束为延长的合唱长音，各环以相反节奏收拢，最终回到与开场完全相同的水晶内部封闭共鸣。
无对白。

[限制] 画面中只有一个人物，两条手臂，两只手，一把剑。人物绝不进入第 1 至 4 栏。所有拉丁文字须完全匹配 @image2 的字形。"CIA0" 须准确拼写，绝不发光、描边、放大或比周围符文更亮。光谱仅以折射形式出现。界面层保持铬色发丝质感，绝不越过面部。特效持续累积直至归位段。双眼仅在 11.4 至 12.6 秒睁开。无日文字符、无品牌标识、无水印、无字幕。首尾帧完全一致，两帧中都不得残留任何浮动文字。.

I've spent a lot of time with Seedance 2.5 over the past couple of days and I've had fun making this

This didn't need confusing AI prompts, it's made with 10 second clips spliced together, a starting image and a character reference.

I'm not here to show you a fully polished, no error clip as that's not a real representation of todays AI.

Things are never perfect first try, but Seedance 2.5 takes us all in a step in the right direction.

records.title: The Paper Boat
records.prompt:
Create a 60-second premium cinematic short film titled “THE PAPER BOAT.”

STYLE:
Photorealistic live-action cinematic realism, emotionally restrained, award-winning short-film cinematography, premium theatrical production quality, natural performances, physically accurate environments, realistic water simulation, authentic atmospheric perspective, subtle film grain, natural HDR, realistic lens behavior, no artificial CGI appearance.
CORE CONCEPT:
The entire film follows one ordinary handmade paper boat on an impossible journey. There is exactly ONE impossible element in the world: this small paper boat can travel wherever connected water flows, no matter how far. Everything else obeys real-world physics.

The audience should initially believe they are watching an ordinary child's paper boat experiment. Only gradually should the journey become extraordinary.
CHARACTER 1:
A quiet 9-year-old South Asian boy with warm medium-brown skin, expressive dark eyes, slightly messy short black hair, slim build, wearing a faded mustard-yellow T-shirt, worn blue shorts and simple sandals. His appearance, clothing, hairstyle, proportions and facial identity remain perfectly consistent whenever he appears.

CHARACTER 2:
An elderly South Asian man around 70 years old, weathered expressive face, silver hair, simple cream shirt, dark trousers and worn sandals. Natural elderly movement, subtle expressions, realistic skin and hair.

THE PAPER BOAT:
One tiny handmade white paper boat folded from slightly creased school notebook paper. Imperfect folds, tiny graphite pencil marks and one faint blue crayon line on one side. It is ordinary paper, not magical-looking. No glow, no symbols, no supernatural appearance. The exact same boat must remain visually recognizable throughout the entire film, becoming slightly damp and worn during its journey.
STORY AND CAMERA:

0–5 SECONDS — THE HOOK
Extreme macro close-up with an 85mm macro lens.

A tiny handmade paper boat floats perfectly still inside a shallow rain puddle after a monsoon shower.
Raindrops strike the water around it.

One large raindrop lands directly inside the boat.

The boat rocks dangerously.

For a moment it looks like it will sink.

Instead, it rights itself.

Rack focus from the rippling water to the boy's reflection in the puddle.

The boy is crouched beside it, silently watching.

Natural breathing, blinking and tiny eye movement.

5–10 SECONDS

Low 35mm tracking shot beside the boy.

He gently pushes the boat forward with one fingertip.

He gives a tiny, genuine smile and quietly whispers:

“Ja... dekhte hain kahan jaati hai.”

Natural child delivery, soft voice, tiny pause between words, no theatrical acting.

The boat begins drifting through a thin stream of rainwater running along the street.

The boy follows it.

His sandals splash naturally through shallow water.

His shirt moves with his running.

Small droplets strike the camera lens.

10–18 SECONDS

The camera drops almost to water level and begins following the paper boat.

The boat enters a narrow concrete drainage channel.

The boy runs alongside it for a few seconds before stopping.

His expression changes from excitement to concern as the boat disappears into the channel.

The camera does NOT cut.

It continues following the boat through the drainage channel.

The narrow concrete environment gradually becomes a larger natural stream.

Use foreground leaves, flowing water and a curtain of dripping vegetation to create a seamless hidden transition.

No teleportation.

No magical transformation.

18–26 SECONDS

The stream becomes a wide river.

The camera slowly rises from water level into a graceful crane movement.

Reveal an enormous realistic river surrounded by countryside.

The tiny paper boat remains the visual anchor.

Warm sunlight begins breaking through clouds.

Wet vegetation glistens.

Birds move naturally through the distant sky.

The boy is now barely visible far behind on the riverbank.

The boat is carried faster by the current.

26–34 SECONDS

The river becomes progressively wider.

The camera remains physically connected to the boat, tracking its movement naturally.

The landscape gradually changes as the river approaches the coast.

The boat enters increasingly turbulent water.

Realistic ripples, foam, reflections and paper deformation.

The camera passes behind a large foreground tree trunk, creating a natural dark-frame transition.

When the camera emerges, the river has reached the ocean.

Reveal a vast open sea.

The tiny boat floats into the enormous expanse.

34–42 SECONDS

The camera tracks directly behind the paper boat at water level.

Ocean waves gently lift and lower it.

The boat is now slightly damp and softened but remains intact and recognizable.

Subtle environmental progression communicates distance and time:

changing cloud formations,
changing sunlight,
changing ocean conditions,
different coastlines appearing and disappearing in the distance.

Use wave spray and foreground water to conceal seamless environmental transitions.

No artificial time-lapse.

No teleportation.

Everything remains physically believable except the boat's impossible ability to continue traveling.

Seabirds occasionally cross the frame.
One bird briefly skims the ocean surface near the boat.
42–48 SECONDS
The ocean gradually approaches a quiet rocky coastline.

The camera moves from behind the boat into a graceful side profile.

A gentle wave carries the boat toward a narrow natural channel leading into a peaceful inland lake.

The soundscape becomes quieter.

The boat enters the lake.

Late-afternoon sunlight now creates warm natural reflections across the water.

Reveal the elderly South Asian man sitting alone beside the lake, sketching quietly in a small notebook.

He hears the water.

He looks up.

48–54 SECONDS

50mm medium close-up.

The elderly man notices the tiny paper boat approaching the shore.

He doesn't react dramatically.

First curiosity.

Then confusion.

Then recognition.

His breathing pauses for a moment.

His eyes soften.

He slowly stands.

The boat gently touches his sandal.

He bends down and carefully picks it up using both hands.

He examines the tiny graphite marks and faint blue crayon line.

A quiet emotional smile appears.

No dialogue.

The emotion must be communicated entirely through micro-expression, eye movement, breathing and body language.

54–60 SECONDS — EMOTIONAL CALLBACK

The elderly man takes a fresh sheet of paper from his notebook.

He begins folding a new paper boat.

Close-up on his hands.

His fingers make the first fold.

MATCH CUT:

The exact same hand movement becomes the 9-year-old boy's hands from the opening scene.

The boy is back beside the original rain puddle.

He places another handmade paper boat onto the water.

The new boat begins drifting.

The camera slowly pulls backward.

The puddle reflects the sky.

The reflection gradually fills the frame.

The reflection visually resembles the enormous lake where the elderly man was sitting.

Hold for one quiet beat.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Professional theatrical cinematography throughout. 35mm and 50mm cinema lenses for narrative shots, 85mm macro for intimate details, natural depth of field, subtle lens breathing, realistic focus pulls, physically motivated camera movement, restrained handheld micro-movement around the child, smooth stabilized tracking around the boat, gradual crane and aerial reveals only when motivated by geography.

The camera must always feel physically present in the environment.

No impossible camera movement.

No random drone shots.

Every camera movement must reveal geography, emotion or scale.

LIGHTING:
Begin with cool, soft post-rain daylight.

Gradually transition into warm sunlight as the boat reaches the river.

Move naturally toward late-afternoon golden light when the elderly man discovers the boat.

Maintain physically consistent shadows, reflections and exposure throughout.
ENVIRONMENTAL REALISM:
Wet concrete, puddles, water droplets, muddy edges, paper fibers, damp clothing, realistic reflections, atmospheric haze, leaves reacting to wind, grass bending naturally, birds responding to the environment, subtle dust and moisture in sunlight, realistic ocean spray, accurate water interaction, natural cloth movement and hair movement.

AUDIO:
Primarily natural diegetic sound.

Rain droplets.
Flowing water.
Footsteps.
Child's breathing.
Distant traffic.
Birds.
Wind.
River current.
Ocean waves.
Paper folding.

Use a restrained cinematic score that gradually builds as the journey expands, then becomes almost silent when the elderly man discovers the boat.

No dialogue after the boy's single sentence.

EMOTIONAL ARC:
Curiosity → excitement → uncertainty → wonder → vastness → quiet discovery → emotional connection → circular beginning.
The film must NOT explain who the elderly man is or why the boat reached him.

Let the audience interpret the connection.

VISUAL RULE:
Everything in the film must look completely real except for the single impossible rule governing the paper boat.

NO:
dragons,
magic particles,
glowing objects,
portals,
fantasy environments,
cyberpunk,
giant objects,
supernatural effects,
text,
subtitles,
logos,
watermarks,
exaggerated acting,
cartoon physics,
unmotivated camera movement,
teleportation,
morphing characters,
duplicate boats,
changing boat design,
character inconsistency,
artificial-looking CGI.

FINAL FEELING:
The film should feel like a real cinematic short that quietly contains one impossible event.
The viewer should finish with the feeling:

“Wait... how did that paper boat get there?”

Then the final image should make them want to watch the entire journey again.

VISUAL PRIORITY:
Photorealism > spectacle.
Emotion > exposition.
Physics > VFX.
Story > technical demonstration.
Subtlety > exaggeration.
Make every frame feel intentionally photographed by a world-class cinematographer rather than generated by an AI model.

The woman stretches toward him as the crocodile rushes in from behind. He grabs her wrist and drags her upward at the last second just as the crocodile leaps, jaws snapping where her legs were.

Shot 3, 9–15s: Both scramble onto the roof, soaked and slipping, barely balancing on the unstable metal sheet. The woman clings to the man in terror. Suddenly the crocodile slams into the roof from the edge or below with brutal force. A huge metallic bang echoes across the floodwater. The roof jolts violently and nearly throws them off. They struggle to stay upright, realizing they are still trapped.

Shot 4, 15–19s: The man and woman struggle to balance on the partially floating tin roof as it shifts beneath them. They look down and realize the whole sheet is unstable and beginning to sink on one side. The crocodile circles around them in the water, occasionally brushing the edge and making the roof wobble.

Shot 5, 19–24s: A rescue helicopter appears overhead through mist and rain haze. Rotor wash whips the floodwater and rattles the roof. The man and woman wave frantically with both hands, screaming for help. For the first time, hope enters the scene.

Shot 6, 24–27s: The crocodile crashes into the roof again, much harder. One side buckles inward and dips lower into the water. Both almost lose footing and slip, barely catching themselves as the roof groans and bends under their weight.

Shot 7, 27–30s: The helicopter crew throws down a rescue ladder toward them. It swings wildly in the wind above the unstable roof. The man and woman turn toward it, trying to steady themselves and move closer while the crocodile keeps circling below. End on the ladder finally dropping within reach as the roof tilts dangerously.

Direct continuation of uploaded video. Same flooded village, same roof, same helicopter and crocodile. This final section should feel chaotic, wet, dangerous and emotionally brutal. The rescue is almost happening, then gets ripped away at the last second.

Shot 1, 0–5s: The man and woman carefully move across the slippery tilted tin roof toward the swinging rescue ladder. Every step is dangerous. The roof is wet, unstable and partly sinking. The woman reaches first while the man steadies her from behind.

Through the distorted water, the crocodile moves directly toward him with deadly speed. Above, we hear the woman screaming helplessly while hanging from the ladder. Cut immediately before impact.

records.prompt:
Hyper-detailed cinematic 30-second luxury car commercial. Clean modern white minimalist garage: seamless white walls, polished light-gray concrete floor with soft reflections, large grid of bright square LED ceiling panels giving even high-key studio lighting and clean specular highlights. Pure controlled environment, commercial-grade polish.

Character lock: A young handsome man in @/image1, mid-20s, dark messy hair, well groomed beard wearing stylish sunglasses, calm confident expression that softens into quiet pride. Crisp off-white short-sleeve button-up shirt (collar slightly open), beige chinos, black-and-white Nike Dunk-style sneakers, black smartwatch on left wrist. Natural skin and fabric texture.

Car lock: Exact Rosso Corsa red Ferrari Portofino convertible. Glossy mirror paint, black soft-top, dual central chrome exhausts, yellow calipers, multi-spoke alloys, prancing-horse badges, black grille, red mirrors. Dubai plate “DUBAI EE 67554”. Large elegant purple satin gift bow with long ribbons centered on the hood (appears after initial reveal). Perfect ceiling-grid reflections on every panel.

Shot-by-shot timeline:

0.0–2.5s  
Wide slightly low-angle establishing. The red Ferrari sits fully under a black car wrap/cover on the left side of the empty white garage. Man enters from the right, back to camera, walks slowly and confidently toward the car. As he approaches, the black wrap begins to slide and peel off the car in a slow, elegant motion, gradually revealing the glossy red body underneath. Soft footsteps. Camera dollies forward and tracks left with him. Ceiling lights create geometric floor reflections.

2.5–5.0s  
Medium tracking. He reaches driver’s side, turns, looks at the car with a subtle almost-smile, places right hand gently on roof/A-pillar and slides it along the body. Low-angle close-up of face and hand on glossy red paint. Soft overhead key + gentle rim light.

5.0–7.5s  
Medium-wide. Purple satin bow now perfectly on hood. Man walks around the front from right to left, hands in pockets, stops at driver’s door and opens it smoothly. Camera slowly orbits front three-quarter as door opens.

7.5–12.5s  
Intimate interior sequence.  
Low angle from passenger side as he steps in. Settles into red leather driver’s seat, grips red Ferrari steering wheel with both hands, adjusts slightly, looks down then forward with quiet intensity. Realistic body weight shift. Red interior, black soft-top above, ceiling grid visible through windshield. Camera stays inside, gentle push-in toward face and hands.

12.5–15.5s  
Dramatic low front close-up of aggressive fascia, headlights and purple bow. Slow subtle push-in. Perfect light reflections on paint.

15.5–17.5s  
Low rear three-quarter tracking of dual exhausts and circular taillights. Camera slowly rises and orbits left, revealing more side profile.

17.5–20.5s  
Elevated wide shot. Man outside again, leaning forward carefully wiping front hood badge with his finger. Stands, walks around front toward passenger side, hands in pockets, calm and proud. Smooth cinematic orbit following him.

20.5–23.0s  
Medium of him beside open driver’s door looking at the car, then clean close-up of Ferrari prancing-horse badge on front fender with glossy red paint and ceiling reflections.

23.0–26.0s  
Wide side profile. Black soft-top retracts automatically — rear deck opens, roof folds and disappears into rear compartment. Man already seated inside looking toward camera. Camera slowly arcs around driver’s side as top fully opens.

26.0–28.0s  
Intimate medium close-up through open driver’s side. Man sits in red leather seat, one hand on wheel, looks directly at camera with composed, slightly proud expression. Soft light on face, red body framing him.

28.0–30.0s  
Final hero wide. Man stands casually leaning against driver’s side of fully open-top Ferrari, left hand in pocket, looking toward camera with quiet confidence. Purple bow still on hood. Perfect composition in bright white garage. Slow gentle push-in. Hold final beat.

Style & technical: Photorealistic cinematic commercial, 24fps filmic motion, shallow-to-medium DOF, ultra-clean high-end grade (rich reds, pure whites, soft neutrals). Perfect material response: mirror paint, soft satin bow, realistic leather and cotton. Smooth professional moves only (dollies, orbits, gentle push-ins). Exact character and car consistency every shot. Emotional tone: quiet luxury, personal achievement, understated joy of a dream gift.

Negative: blurry faces, deformed hands, extra people, text, watermarks, low quality, cartoon proportions, oversaturated colors, dark lighting, shaky cam.

records.prompt:
Use @[character ref] only for the Hunter’s referenced appearance; ignore its background. Use @[environment ref] only for the sunlit sacred sci-fi forest above clouds: colossal trees, mossy platforms, torii gates, waterfalls and floating ruins. Use no other image as a visual reference.

Exactly five feral flying monsters: leathery wings, hooked talons, armored skulls and predatory jaws. Keep each distinct: twin-horned, torn-wingtip, bone-faced, fork-tailed and red-throated. Begin with five living monsters and end with none.

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:02.2. A peaceful telephoto view shows all five resting across one mossy branch, grooming and watching the cloud sea. Hold one beat. Without warning, a mint-gold energy ball tears into frame and strikes the twin-horned monster. A violent crack and compact flash startle the viewer. Its whole body becomes black ash and embers in under half a second; nothing intact remains. The four survivors scatter in panic.

Shot 2 — 0:02.2–0:04.4. Smash cut on the flash to a low rear three-quarter wide of the Hunter across a visible gap, aligned with the struck branch as she finishes Throw 1. Energy coils into her palm; she fires Throw 2 as a low sidearm sling. Her release flows directly into a sprint onto the single connecting root toward the lower branch corridor. The ball outruns frame while her route stays visible.

Shot 3 — 0:04.4–0:07.0. Follow the ball as it hooks around a trunk, threads two branches and hits the torn-wingtip monster once. Direct contact, compressed flash, instant full-body ash disintegration. Its ash descends as the other three flee. Cut on impact.

Shot 4 — 0:07.0–0:10.5. Cut back on the same action axis to the run begun in Shot 2. The Hunter remains on that root, farther along, and reaches the already visible lower corridor without resetting her stride. Track low beside her. She plants and snaps an underhand rising throw; the third ball corkscrews through vines, overtakes the bone-faced monster and turns it to ash. Two remain.

Shot 5 — 0:10.5–0:14.0. The fork-tailed monster dives behind a waterfall. The ball appears to miss, then makes one sudden return curve. The Hunter redirects it with a sharp reverse-backhand gesture; it whips through spray and hits. The entire monster bursts into wet black ash, embers and vapor. Only the red-throated monster remains.

Shot 6 — 0:14.0–0:18.0. The red-throated monster claws through branches, folds through a narrow torii gate and dives over open cloud. The Hunter races across roots and collapsing ledges, vaulting gaps without breaking stride. Use rapid pursuit and target glimpses as it dodges and changes altitude.

Shot 7 — 0:18.0–0:23.2. The Hunter leaps from the last platform. The instant both feet leave it, ramp time down to 35–40% speed. Her body extends nearly horizontal, parallel to the cloud horizon. She performs one controlled lateral half-turn, maximum 180 degrees: no extra rotation or repeated spin. Power flows from core through shoulder and arm, compressing into the fifth ball as she aligns with the target. Follow with one measured 90-degree camera arc, never a full orbit. She releases with a sideways snap. The frame the ball leaves her fingertips, return instantly to full speed.

Shot 8 — 0:23.2–0:27.3. At full speed, the fifth ball launches explosively; never let it drift. Chase behind as it slaloms between trunks, drops beneath a bridge, climbs through mist and makes two hard opposite curves against the monster’s evasive dive. It hits the red-throated monster once. A sharp flash consumes its silhouette, converting it into turbulent ash and embers. Nothing intact survives.

Shot 9 — 0:27.3–0:30.0. Punch through the ash cloud, then snap back to the Hunter catching a hanging root and swinging beneath the island at full speed. End on her accelerating swing, not a pose or slow aftermath.

Five throws kill five unique targets in order: twin-horned, torn-wingtip, bone-faced, fork-tailed, red-throated. Never show alive, reform, hit again or retarget a monster after it turns to ash. Every hit converts the whole creature to ash in under half a second; none wobbles, survives, hovers or falls intact. Ash keeps momentum, then scatters downward.

Shots 1–6 and 8–9 run at full or accelerated speed. Only Shot 7 is slow motion, from takeoff to fingertip separation. Never slow projectile travel or impacts. Orbs form rapidly, releases snap hard and curved paths cross distance in moments.

High-end cinematic anime realism with sakuga energy. Throws show readable weight transfer and abrupt release. Use clear geography, forceful tracking, hard cuts, strong parallax and brief foreshortened close shots. Foliage, mist and spray react violently. Preserve identity, count, route geography and action axis. Sound: deceptive calm, shocking first crack, five throw snaps, supersonic passes, panic, five ash-burst impacts, wind and waterfalls.

records.prompt:
30-second one continuous take: a woman standing in a rain-soaked city intersection at night reshapes the world with enormous sweeping gestures. Her power is not magic. It is compositing.

[MultiModal Reference Layer]

No reference image is provided. Build everything from the blocks below.

<Woman>: late forties, tall, close-cropped grey hair. A heavy charcoal wool greatcoat to mid-calf, collar up, soaked through and hanging with real weight, worn boots. Nothing in her hands. Her gestures are enormous, slow and precise, both arms working, more conductor than fighter. She never smiles, strains, poses or looks at the camera.

<Intersection>: a city crossroads at night in heavy rain. Wet black asphalt mirroring everything, a stalled red double-decker bus with its interior lights on, three taxis at the lights, a thirty-storey tower of lit windows on one corner, layered neon in red, jade and magenta, thirty pedestrians under clear umbrellas, deep puddles.

<Interface>: flat single-pixel cyan vector lines with no thickness. Hollow square handles at the corners of every bounding box, an anchor crosshair at each centre, dashed marquee rectangles, a slider with a square thumb, a hard-edged rectangular mask outline with side handles, a timeline strip with diamond keyframes and a playhead. Labels in plain white sans-serif reading only ROTATE, OPACITY, MIRROR, TIME, MASK.

[Global Settings]

THE INTERFACE RULE, the hardest part of the piece: interface elements exist in real three-dimensional space at real scale, not flat on the screen. A gizmo around a tower block is as tall as the tower block. Everything is perspective-correct and shifts correctly as the camera moves. Critically they are OCCLUDED by real objects in front of them, so a passing umbrella hides part of a bounding box and reveals it on the far side, and rain falls in front of every line. The interface has NO glow, emits no light, casts no shadow and does not reflect in the road.

THE EFFECTS RULE: every change lands on the real world physically. A rotated building is a real building at that angle with a correctly rotated shadow. A faded crowd is genuinely semi-transparent with the road visible through them. A masked region is real daylight on real dry ground. Nothing pops, flashes, sparkles or glows. Changes land in a single frame or over a smooth drag, never with an effect.

Base environment: photoreal cinematic, anamorphic, shallow focus, 35mm grain, practical light only. Everything wet and mirrored. Never stylised, never fantasy, never science fiction. Apart from the vector overlay this is a documentary photograph of a wet city at night.

Shot language: ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, no hard cuts. A single very slow arc around her, from past her left shoulder to past her right across the full thirty seconds, so the perspective on every interface element changes continuously.

Performance core: she is not performing power, she is doing work. No flourishes, no hero poses, no glance at the lens. Pedestrians never react, never look at her and never break stride.

LIGHT: at night only neon, shop windows, headlights and traffic signals, hard coloured keys from several directions, deep unlit shadow between them, heavy speculars on every wet surface. Inside the masked rectangle: flat overcast midday, soft, shadowless, dry pale tarmac. The two meet on a razor-sharp vertical line with no blend and no spill.

PHYSICS: real weight and real water. Rain falls at real speed and splashes on impact. Standing water ripples from every footfall and the mirrored neon breaks and reforms with it. Her soaked coat swings with delay. The rotating tower has enormous mass and structural inertia. The bus sheds water in sheets. Reversed time reverses everything at the same rate.

[Negative Prompts]: force mute, no BGM, no soundtrack, no score, no music of any kind. No dialogue, narration or chanting. No subtitles beyond the interface labels. No Doctor Strange, no Marvel, no cloak of levitation, no sling ring, no comic book character, no existing franchise, this is an original design. No glowing mandala spell circles, rune rings, sigils, sparks, energy, particles, light beams, holograms or HUD. The interface never glows, reflects or lies flat on the camera plane. No screens or phones. No flashes, dissolves or cuts. No fighting or destruction, nobody is hurt. No slow motion.

[Timestamp Storyboard]

[00:00 - 00:04] [Arrival] Nothing happens

Action: WIDE, low, the camera beginning its slow arc past her left shoulder. <Woman> walks into the middle of the crossing against the flow of umbrellas, stops and stands. Rain hammers down, traffic waits, nobody looks at her. She takes her hands from her pockets. Four full seconds pass and nothing supernatural happens.

Audio: <torrential rain> <traffic idling> <crowd murmur and footsteps in standing water>

[00:04 - 00:08] [Rotate] The tower

Action: still arcing. She raises both arms and turns her hands outward. A cyan wireframe box snaps around the entire thirty-storey tower, handles at every corner, a rotation ring at its base, labelled ROTATE. She turns both hands and the tower rotates thirty degrees on the spot, every lit window turning with it, the reflected neon swinging round on the wet road beneath, its shadow sweeping across the crowd. Nobody looks up.

Audio: <a dry snap as the box engages> <an enormous deep grinding rotation felt more than heard> <water sheeting off the facade>

[00:08 - 00:13] [Opacity] The crowd

Action: still arcing. She flicks two fingers at the pedestrians on the near crossing. A slider appears beside them with a square thumb, labelled OPACITY 100%. She drags it left and the entire crowd fades to thirty percent transparent, the wet road and kerb visible straight through thirty bodies, their reflections fading by exactly the same amount, umbrellas fading with them. They keep walking and nobody notices. One taxi driving through them stays completely solid.

Audio: <an interface tick> <footsteps and crowd murmur unchanged> <a taxi through standing water>

[00:13 - 00:18] [Mirror] The street repeats

Action: still arcing. She brings her hands together at her chest then pulls them apart in a long slow spread. Dashed cyan marquee lines draw outward across the intersection, labelled MIRROR, and the street duplicates: four identical copies of the crossroads unfold in a symmetrical tiling, each with its own tower, bus and translucent crowd, receding to a false horizon. People walk out of one copy into the next without breaking stride. The reflections tile too.

Audio: <rain and crowd multiplying into a denser wash> <four sets of traffic overlapping out of phase>

[00:18 - 00:23] [Time] The scrub

Action: still arcing. She draws a horizontal timeline strip into the air at chest height, diamond keyframes along it, a vertical playhead, labelled TIME. She hooks the playhead with two fingers and drags it left. The entire tiled intersection runs backward at the speed of her drag: rain lifts off the road and rises in continuous unbroken threads, puddle splashes suck back into flat water, the translucent crowd walks backward, taxis reverse through the junction. She stops and everything holds dead still, rain suspended in every direction. Hold longer than comfortable.

Audio: <the street reversed into a low pulled wash> <rain running upward> <then stillness with a faint neon hum>

[00:23 - 00:27] [Mask] Daylight

Action: still arcing. She raises one flat hand and draws it slowly across the frame left to right. A hard-edged rectangular mask outline follows her hand with handles on every side, labelled MASK, and inside the rectangle the world is completely different: the same intersection in flat dry overcast midday, no rain, dry pale tarmac, a different crowd in summer clothes. Outside it is still night, still raining, still tiled, still suspended. The boundary is a razor-sharp vertical line with no blend and no spill, and rain falls down the outside and stops dead at the edge. She drags a side handle and the daylight widens until it fills most of the frame, then drags it back to a narrow band.

Audio: <inside the mask, dry daytime ambience with birds> <outside it, suspended silence> <the two side by side with no crossfade>

[00:27 - 00:30] [Collapse] Everything back

Action: the camera completes its arc past her right shoulder and rests. She closes both hands into fists. Every change collapses at once in a single frame: the mask closes to nothing, the tiling folds back into one street, time snaps forward and the suspended rain falls all at once in a wall, the crowd returns to full opacity, the tower back at its original angle, every interface element gone. The intersection must match the first frame precisely. She lowers her head, puts her hands back in her pockets and walks out of frame. FINAL FRAME: the rain-soaked intersection at night, stalled red bus with its lights on, tower of lit windows, neon mirrored in the black road, three taxis at the lights, thirty pedestrians under umbrellas, nobody in the crossing. Hold on this exact composition.

Audio: <one dry click> <the full street returning at once> <a wall of rain hitting the road> <her boots in standing water, receding>

[Maintain Consistency]

<Woman> keeps the same coat, hair and boots for all thirty seconds, soaked from the first frame. The <Intersection> is identical in the first and last frames: same red bus in the same place, same tower at the same angle, same three taxis, same neon, same puddles, same thirty pedestrians. Every effect STACKS on the ones before it and none are undone until the final collapse. The <Interface> uses the same cyan, line weight and typeface every time, is always perspective-correct, always occluded by objects in front of it, and never glows or reflects. Pedestrians never react at any point. The rain never stops except while time is held. No music at any point.

records.title: Three A.M. French Nightlife POV
records.prompt:
A 30 second ultra realistic handheld POV video set in France at around 3 am, outside a busy bar and nightlife street. The camera is the point of view of a young woman filming one handed on an iPhone. We never see the phone itself at any point. The footage must feel like raw, authentic amateur nightlife footage with natural iPhone aesthetics.

It is very late. People are leaving bars, smoking outside, waiting for Ubers, talking too loudly, eating kebabs, laughing in tired, sloppy groups. The mood in the street is a mix of drunken energy and visible exhaustion. Faces look tired, makeup is slightly worn, outfits are a bit messy after a long night. The pavement is slightly wet and reflects neon signs, headlights, and warm bar lights. The air feels cold and heavy. The whole scene must feel intensely real, socially awkward, and uncomfortable.

The camera operator is a woman, and her friend is another young woman walking a few steps ahead of her, visibly angry. The camera follows her in a shaky, one-handed handheld way. The tension is already there from the first second. The argument is about the friend disappearing with a guy inside the bar and leaving the camera operator alone for nearly an hour, which made her miss the last train and feel abandoned. This is the core of the argument.

The friend suddenly turns around while still walking and says in natural French from France:

“Tu vas me suivre encore longtemps comme ça ?”

The woman behind the camera replies, irritated and hurt:

“Bah ouais, parce que tu m’as laissée toute seule comme une conne pendant une heure.”

The friend rolls her eyes, tired and defensive:

“Oh ça va, j’étais pas ‘avec un mec’, on parlait, c’est bon.”

The camera gets a little closer as the woman filming answers immediately:

“Mais arrête, tu m’as complètement lâchée. J’te cherchais partout.”

The friend stops walking and turns fully toward the camera now, angry but exhausted:

“J’allais pas te tenir la main toute la soirée non plus.”

A few people nearby start glancing at them. Someone exits a bar laughing, a smoker looks over, a taxi passes in the background. The world keeps moving around them, but the argument becomes the emotional center of the scene.

The woman filming replies, more intense now:

“C’est pas ça le problème, le problème c’est que t’as disparu sans rien dire. J’ai raté le dernier train à cause de toi.”

The friend laughs bitterly in disbelief:

“À cause de moi ? Sérieux ? T’es incapable de te débrouiller toute seule ?”

The camera jolts slightly from the emotional reaction. The breathing of the woman filming becomes more noticeable. Her voice gets sharper:

“Mais t’abuses en fait. Tu fais toujours ça. Tu penses qu’à toi.”

The friend steps closer, now visibly losing patience:

“Et toi tu fais quoi là ? Tu me filmes en pleine rue comme une malade.”

The woman behind the camera replies immediately:

“Parce que tu racontes n’importe quoi !”

The friend reaches toward the camera, not to grab a visible phone, but clearly trying to push it away from her face. The image jerks sideways hard from the contact.

“Enlève ça de ma tête !”

The camera operator snaps back:

“Me touche pas !”

Now the tension breaks completely. The friend, furious and emotionally overwhelmed, shouts:

“Mais ferme-la un peu !”

The woman filming fires back:

“Sinon quoi ?!”

There is a half-second pause. Heavy breathing. Eye contact directly into the lens. Then the friend lunges.

She pushes into the camera operator. The footage becomes chaotic and violent, shaking hard as the woman filming loses balance. She lets out a shocked cry:

“Putain !”

The camera stumbles backward and drops toward the ground. As it falls, we catch blurred fragments: legs, jackets, streetlights, pavement, people turning around, someone shouting:

“Eh oh ! Ça va pas ou quoi ?!”

The friend jumps onto her as both fall out of balance. The camera lands badly on the ground, still recording for a split second, partly blocked by clothing or the ground. We hear struggling, overlapping voices, panic, and nearby people reacting. Then the video abruptly cuts.

The entire performance must feel spontaneous, messy, and completely believable. Natural interruptions, overlapping dialogue, breath, hesitation, frustration, and tiny realistic body movements are essential. The acting must feel like a real late night argument between two exhausted friends, not a scripted drama. No cinematic polish, no stylized fight choreography, no slow motion, no music, no visible phone, no artificial lighting setup, and no glamorous performance. It must feel like a real one handed iPhone recording captured in the heat of the moment.

records.title: Desert Hoverboard Ruin Run
records.useCase: Text prompt, Video or motion reference
records.prompt:
SOURCE AND CONTINUATION
Extend @video1. This is a direct continuation that begins at the exact frame where @video1 ends — the same ride, the same day, the next stretch of desert. Every shot below is new material that happens after the source footage, not a retelling of it.
Preserve exactly from @video1: the rider's identity, helmet and visor, black riding suit, gloves and boots; the hoverboard and its cyan underglow; the desert world, dune shapes and haze; the low golden sun and its direction; the colour grade; and the music, which continues unbroken in the same key, tempo and arrangement with no restart.
CHARACTERS
The rider: same man from @video1, full dark helmet with a clear visor and two white light strips, black armored riding suit, gloves, boots. Identical in every shot. He rides the same hoverboard, lit underneath by a continuous cyan strip.
LOCATION MAP
Foreground: open sand, wind-carved ripples, loose grit lifting off the crests.
Midground: the ride path — dunes flattening into a cracked salt pan that runs into a post-apocalyptic ruin field of collapsed concrete slabs, leaning steel columns, half-buried vehicle hulls and broken roadway sections.
Background: a low sandstone cliff wall on the far side of the ruins, and beyond it open sky with the sun sitting low on the horizon.
The rider travels camera-left to camera-right in every lateral view. The sun stays low and ahead of him, camera-right, throughout.
FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Full-frame lateral profile close-up of the rider, 18°, camera tracking alongside him at his own speed, his helmet filling the right third of frame in sharp profile, dunes streaking past behind him, cyan board glow spilling up onto his boots from below.
FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot with HARD CUTS only at 4.0s, 8.0s, 12.0s, 15.0s, 19.0s, 23.5s and 27.0s. The camera cuts only at these points. Real-time playback everywhere except 19.0–23.5s, which is slow motion; the speed change happens only on those two hard cuts.
STORYBOARD
SHOT 1 (0.0–4.0s)
Lateral profile close-up, 18°, camera tracking beside him at 60 km/h, level with his shoulder. He rides steady, head turning a few degrees forward as the ruins come into his sightline, then his shoulders drop slightly and he leans in. Sand streams off the board's trailing edge behind him. Low sun rakes across the front of his visor from camera-right, leaving the far side of his helmet in deep shade.
SHOT 2 (4.0–8.0s)
HARD CUT to an extreme wide, 84°, camera high and static as he crosses the frame camera-left to camera-right at 60 km/h, a small figure with a cyan thread of light beneath him. Ahead of him the ruin field opens up — collapsed slabs and leaning steel standing as tall as six humans, throwing long shadows across the salt pan.
SHOT 3 (8.0–12.0s)
HARD CUT to a low tracking shot, 47°, camera 30 cm off the ground running with him at 70 km/h as he enters the ruins. He weaves between two leaning columns, board tilting hard onto its edge, a sheet of sand and grit fanning off the tail. Broken concrete passes close on both sides. Cyan underglow flares against the slab faces as he passes them.
SHOT 4 (12.0–15.0s)
HARD CUT to a medium shot from the front quarter, 29°, camera drifting backward ahead of him at 70 km/h. He drops into a deep drift, both arms out for balance, the board sliding sideways through a curve of debris, a long curtain of dust thrown out behind him and catching the low sun. His head stays locked on his line through the turn.
SHOT 5 (15.0–19.0s)
HARD CUT to a low rear three-quarter shot, 63°, camera accelerating with him from 70 to 110 km/h. He crouches, drives his weight forward, and the board's cyan strip brightens as it surges. Ahead of him a broken roadway section rises out of the sand at a shallow angle, its torn edge lifted clear of the ground. He hits it square and launches.
SHOT 6 (19.0–23.5s)
HARD CUT into SLOW MOTION. Wide side view, 47°, camera craning slowly upward with him against the low sun. He is airborne at the apex, board still under his feet, one hand gripping the front edge, knees folded. A full curtain of sand hangs suspended around and beneath him, every grain lit gold from camera-right and drifting rather than falling. The cyan glow underneath him rakes across the suspended sand. The whole shot stays in slow motion start to finish.
SHOT 7 (23.5–27.0s)
HARD CUT back to real time. Low tracking shot, 47°, camera behind and beside him. He lands hard, board slapping the sand and compressing, a burst of grit blowing outward from the impact, and he rides straight out of it at 110 km/h across the last open stretch toward the sandstone cliffs. The ruins fall away behind him.
SHOT 8 (27.0–30.0s)
HARD CUT to a lateral profile medium shot, 29°, camera settling alongside him and coming to rest as he does. He carves the board hard sideways and brakes, throwing a low wide sheet of sand forward and to camera-right, and stops at the cliff edge. He straightens up, squares his shoulders, and turns his helmet to face the sun sitting on the horizon. Held final frame: the rider in profile at the cliff edge, sand still settling around the board, the cyan glow steady beneath him, the sun low ahead of him.
PERFORMANCE
Everything reads through the body, since his face is behind the visor: weight shifting into each turn, arms counterbalancing the drift, the deep crouch before the launch, the folded stillness at the apex, the absorbed compression of the landing, and the settled straightening at the very end. Restrained and controlled throughout — a rider who knows this ground.
PHYSICS
The board carries real mass and inertia. It leans into turns and rebounds on landing. Sand behaves as loose dry grain: it fans off the edge under load, hangs in a curtain in slow motion, blows outward in a burst on impact, and settles slowly at the end. Dust catches and scatters the low sun. Wind drags loose grit off the dune crests continuously. Debris in the ruins stays put; only sand and dust move.
LIGHTING
Fixed 3200K golden-hour sun, low on the horizon ahead of the rider and camera-right, unchanged in every shot. Hard warm key on the front of his suit and visor, deep shade on the far side, long shadows running away camera-left across the sand and the ruin floor. Airborne dust glows where it crosses the sun. Cyan board light acts as a cold practical from below, catching his boots, the sand under him and nearby slab faces.
AUDIO
The music from @video1 continues unbroken through the whole extension — same track, same key, same tempo, no restart and no new song. Under it: the low hum of the board, wind across open sand, grit spraying off the edge, concrete and steel echoing close in the ruins.
At 19.0s the mix thins for the slow-motion shot — the music drops to a single sustained low note, and the suspended sand and the board's hum sit at the front.
At 23.5s the full arrangement returns hard on the landing impact.
In the final shot the music resolves and holds under open desert wind. No dialogue anywhere.
OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9, real-time in every segment except 19.0–23.5s, which is slow motion.
POSITIVE LOCKS
This is a continuation of @video1 — all action takes place after the source footage ends.
The rider, helmet, visor light strips, suit and the hoverboard's cyan underglow stay identical to @video1 in every shot.
The rider travels camera-left to camera-right in every lateral view, and the sun stays low and camera-right in every shot.
One continuous piece of music runs from the first frame to the last, carried over from @video1.
The board keeps complete geometry and stays under his feet through the jump and landing.
Cuts land only at the stated seconds, and the speed change to slow motion happens only at 19.0s and back at 23.5s.
The video ends on the held profile of the rider stopped at the cliff edge, facing the low sun.

records.title: Cartoon Bulldog Versus Live Boxer
records.prompt:
Create an intense 24-second boxing sequence in 10 shots.

The bulldog remains a hand-drawn 2D character inspired by 1969 American TV cartoons, keeping the same face, proportions, red gloves, and striped shorts. Never make him realistic. The human boxer remains fully photorealistic.

Style: heated live sports documentary broadcast. Handheld ringside cameras, reactive pans, imperfect reframing, small zoom corrections, natural shake, motion blur, focus breathing, faded 35mm colors, soft lens bloom, subtle gate weave, and naturally changing film grain. No frozen grain or fixed texture.

Strong white spotlights illuminate the ring. The crowd is darker but visible and constantly reacting. Crowd cheering continues from the first frame to the last: shouting, applause, whistles, and stomping. Reactions grow louder after major punches. An excited male English commentator speaks continuously. No music.

Each numbered shot is one continuous camera take. The camera may pan, track, dolly, or reframe, but must not jump to a new position inside the same shot.

Comic effects must resemble authentic 1969 American comics: imperfect hand-drawn lines, thick black outlines, red, yellow, white, and black colors, halftone dots, faded ink, and slight print misregistration.

Use effects sparingly:
SPEED LINES on fast punches.
One-frame SMEAR FRAME on the strongest punches.
Small IMPACT BURSTS on selected hits.
IMPACT FLASH and SHOCKWAVE RING only on the decisive counter and final uppercut.
WOBBLE LINES and yellow rotating stars only when the human is badly dazed.

Use only these comic sound effects on major clean hits:
THWACK! POW! SMACK! WHAM! CRACK!

SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.0
High-angle view of the packed arena. The ring is under strong spotlights. Both fighters wait in opposite corners. The bell rings, the crowd erupts, and both walk toward the center as the camera pushes closer.

SHOT 2 — 2.0–4.0
Slightly elevated wide shot from outside the ring with ropes in the foreground. The referee steps back. Both fighters raise their guards, circle, and test distance. The handheld camera tracks right.

SHOT 3 — 4.0–6.2
Low canvas-level angle. The bulldog throws a jab with brief SPEED LINES. The human narrowly avoids it and counters with a jab that the bulldog blocks. Quick natural pan. No comic text.

SHOT 4 — 6.2–8.8
Slightly high-angle shot through the ropes. The human attacks with a combination. A left jab lands with a small IMPACT BURST and THWACK! A right straight follows with POW!, a brief IMPACT FLASH, and a small burst. A left hook lands with only a subtle impact mark. The camera tracks as the bulldog retreats.

SHOT 5 — 8.8–11.2
Close handheld shot from the opposite side. The human keeps pressing with short punches. The bulldog blocks several and absorbs one body shot. The camera urgently reframes. The bulldog answers with a short face hook using a small red IMPACT BURST and SMACK!

SHOT 6 — 11.2–14.0
Over-the-shoulder from behind the human. The human throws a powerful right straight. The bulldog slips underneath. The camera pans with the missed glove. Without cutting, the bulldog plants his feet, rotates, and launches a right counterpunch with SPEED LINES and a one-frame SMEAR FRAME.

SHOT 7 — 14.0–16.8
Tight ringside impact shot. The bulldog’s right straight lands on the human’s cheek in very brief slow motion. His cheek compresses and sweat flies. At contact, show a large IMPACT BURST, white IMPACT FLASH, radial lines, short SHOCKWAVE RING, and WHAM! The effects vanish immediately. Return to normal speed as the human staggers backward. The crowd explodes.

SHOT 8 — 16.8–19.2
Slightly elevated ringside shot. The human is badly dazed but standing. WOBBLE LINES and three yellow stars briefly appear. The bulldog lands one body punch without text, then a short face hook with SPEED LINES, a small burst, and SMACK!

SHOT 9 — 19.2–21.5
Low diagonal ringside angle. The bulldog throws a compact uppercut with a one-frame SMEAR FRAME. It lands under the chin with IMPACT FLASH, red-yellow IMPACT BURST, short SHOCKWAVE RING, and CRACK! The human falls into the ropes, drops to one knee, and collapses safely. The referee stops the fight. The bulldog steps back. Yellow stars fade.

SHOT 10 — 21.5–24.0
Final slightly high-angle wide shot. The referee brings the bulldog to the center and raises one arm. Red-and-white paper streamers fly into the ring. Vintage photographers fire flashbulbs and strong white strobes. The crowd remains standing, shouting, clapping, whistling, and waving hats. The handheld camera slowly pushes closer until the final frame.

16.2-17.6 ORBIT, slow motion, macro: one tin tips off the top of the tower.

19.2-20.6 Low track alongside a bicycle now, a crate of tins lashed to the rear rack, lane blurring.

records.prompt:
